cards.limitation: This recording study supports re-expression of activity relationships; it does not establish subjective replay or demonstrate that every reactivation improves memory.
cards.lora_analogy_NOT_paper_finding: Reusing selected training examples may be called replay operationally, but adapter optimization does not thereby acquire rat hippocampal mechanisms.
cards.source_backed_explanation: Hippocampal place cells that were coactive during spatial behavior were more likely to be coactive again during subsequent slow-wave sleep than preceding sleep.

cards.limitation: A specific cueing result is not a claim that all memories improve during sleep or that the same process applies to every memory system.
cards.lora_analogy_NOT_paper_finding: A scheduled adapter-update phase is an engineered procedure. Calling it sleep does not establish slow-wave physiology, biological consolidation, or dreaming.
cards.source_backed_explanation: Re-presenting a learning-associated odor during slow-wave sleep improved retention in the tested declarative-memory task, but not the tested procedural-memory task. Effects depended on learning context and cue timing.

cards.limitation: Rest is not a blank or inactive brain. The finding does not identify every resting thought or show that default-mode activity equals self-awareness.
cards.lora_analogy_NOT_paper_finding: Idle inference, free generation, and background computation are software conditions, not evidence that a language model has a human default-mode network.
cards.source_backed_explanation: Metabolic measurements supported an organized resting baseline. A set of brain regions consistently decreased activity relative to that baseline during many goal-directed tasks.

cards.limitation: Structural correlations do not establish causation or provide direct access to subjective experience. Confidence, correctness, and metacognitive sensitivity are different quantities.
cards.lora_analogy_NOT_paper_finding: Model confidence can be evaluated against externally scored outcomes, but successful prediction is not a demonstration of human-like introspection.
cards.source_backed_explanation: Confidence distinguished correct from incorrect perceptual decisions with individual differences separable from task performance. This ability correlated with anterior prefrontal gray matter and connected white-matter structure.

closing_boundary: Memory is assessed here through specified behavioral and physiological evidence. None of these papers validates therapy for language models, model feelings, or a one-to-one mapping from neural anatomy to LoRA parameters.
frame: Human neuroscience and a rat comparison are described first. LoRA comparisons are engineering analogies, not biological equivalences or consciousness evidence.
